title: Zombie Compositions in Assembly Algebras and an Upper Bound on the Size of Chemical Space
summary: In this paper we present construction systems -- tuples $(X, BB, \oplus, ν)$ comprising objects, building blocks, an assembly operation, and a joining multiplicity -- as a general algebraic framework for studying how complex objects are built from simpler parts. To each construction system we associate a toric ideal, a toric variety, and a matroid, obtaining analytical bounds on the growth function $N(a)$ (the number of objects of construction complexity $\leq a$) purely from the design signature $(m, ν, n_0)$.
